claude.rationale: gap_45=1: the slice states the Mountain Pass credit-bid sale transferred the subsurface mineral rights and water-treatment process IP (SorbX/PhosFIX trademarks and process patents) to Secure Natural Resources LLC, but "the mineral-rights and process-IP thus crossed the ownership boundary to the buyer without the producing/processing plant and its associated operating entity moving alongside them" — a product/asset transferred without the operational plant that produces it. gap_56=1: T5/T6 mismatch is documented because the physical mine facility and its holding entities and "their personnel" remained with the severed Molycorp Minerals Debtors under a Chapter 11 trustee, separating processes/people from the assets sold. gap_mitigated=no: the slice records severance/withdrawal and a Chapter 7-conversion motion with no transitional-services or operating agreement allocating the shared mine substrate to the buyer at closing.

gemini.rationale: The transaction split the enterprise into multiple pieces (1-N across T2-T6). The downstream businesses reorganized under a new parent, while the Mountain Pass mineral rights and water-treatment IP (T4 assets) were sold to a separate buyer without the physical mining/processing facility (T5) moving alongside them, creating a gap_45. The physical facility and its holding entity were left behind under a Chapter 11 trustee, separating the mine-holding entities and their personnel (T6) from the reorganized downstream group and the sold assets, creating a gap_56. There is no mention of a transitional services agreement mitigating these gaps.

openai.rationale: The Mountain Pass sale transferred mineral rights, water-treatment IP, trademarks, process patents, contracts, and goodwill, while the physical mining and processing facility and its operating entity remained behind in severed cases; this documents a product/asset-versus-process mismatch at closing [SRC: SEC accession 0001104659-16-120339, Form 8-K Item 1.03]. The same structure separated the transferred process IP from the mine-holding entities and their personnel, while the downstream operations and management moved together as a going concern, documenting a process-versus-organization gap only in the Mountain Pass portion [SRC: SEC accession 0001104659-16-120339, Form 8-K Item 1.03] [SRC: SEC accession 0001489137-16-000120, Form 8-K Item 1.03]. No transitional-services or operating agreement allocating that separated substrate is documented in the slice.
